snippet.title: Fangtopia - Announce Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10018955/

Fangtopia is coming to PS5 this spooky season! A cosy tile-placement puzzler game where you grow a haunted world by connecting terrain, landmarks and monster habitats. Match tiles, place landmarks, discover monsters with no time pressures. Meet werewolves, yetis, scarecrows and more while taking on your friends to unlock over 40 unique landmarks. Multiple modes to match your vibes, compete with friends to top the leaderboard for the crown of Fangtopia. 

#ps5 #ps5games
